name: handover
from: The Low budget hook: a budget of 1 hands over to a fresh coordinator, which ships the second ticket.

tickets.title: Add a shout function
tickets.body: Add `shout(text)` to the package. It returns the text in upper case with a `!` at the end. Add a unit test.

tickets.title: Add a whisper function
tickets.body: Add `whisper(text)` to the package. It returns the text in lower case. Add a unit test.
